scope: Three U.S. critical-material and critical-mineral manufactured commodities (electrical steel, silicon carbide, synthetic graphite) and eleven IMA September 2026 critical-element mineral species (bainbridgeite-(NdCe), piilonenite-(Nd), mckelveyite-(Y), adamsite-(Y), thomasclarkite-(Y), petrukite, ferrokesterite, sakuraiite, ammonioborite, weeksite, richetite) with complete primary-source visual inspection and bounded abiotic or structural claims. No microbial activity, industrial deployment, or unmeasured elemental recovery inferred.

selection.reason: Missing U.S. DOE 2023 Critical Material for Energy (88 FR 51792, 51797); distinct grain-oriented and non-grain-oriented Fe-Si alloy commodity separate from elemental silicon and bulk steel.

Missing U.S. DOE 2023 Critical Material for Energy (88 FR 51792, 51797); distinct wide-bandgap semiconductor and manufactured abrasive commodity supported by DOE 2023 Critical Materials Assessment and USGS MCS 2026 Manufactured Abrasives and Silicon chapters.

Missing U.S. critical-mineral commodity (included on Final 2023 DOE Critical Materials List via DOI/USGS 2022 Critical Mineral List Footnote 6, while scored 'Not Critical' for energy alone in DOE Table 1); distinct manufactured graphite commodity separate from natural graphite, supported by DOE 2023 Critical Materials Assessment (259,000 t domestic shipments in 2021), USGS 2021 Minerals Yearbook Graphite, and USGS MCS 2026 Graphite.
Missing IMA:2023-018 Nd-Ce-ordered mckelveyite-group carbonate from Mont Saint-Hilaire (holotype CMNMC 90534, hornfels CMNMC 52468); complete EJM 38 (2026) 419-429 primary PDF inspected.

Missing IMA:2025-031 (IMA Master List 2025-031b) Nd-dominant layered NaNd(CO3)2(H2O)3 carbonate from Poudrette quarry chemically analogous to adamsite-(Y) and shomiokite-(Y); complete EJM 38 (2026) 337-345 primary PDF and IMA Master List inspected.

Missing IMA:1964-025 (1965 Wyoming description and 2008 monoclinic mckelveyite-(Y)-2M crystal-structure refinement from Val Malenco, Italy compared with triclinic mckelveyite-(Y)-1A) Y-dominant carbonate; complete AM 50 (1965) 593-612 and CM 46 (2008) 195-204 primary PDFs inspected.

Missing IMA:1999-020 Y-dominant sodium-yttrium carbonate hexahydrate from Poudrette quarry (cotypes CMNMC 82939 and 82940); complete CM 38 (2000) 1457-1466 primary PDF inspected, including N2 TGA/DTG dehydration and partial decarbonation.

Missing IMA:1997-047 Y-dominant sodium-rare-earth bicarbonate hydrate from Poudrette quarry (cotypes CMNMI 81553-81555); complete CM 36 (1998) 1293-1300 primary PDF inspected, including 38.8 wt% total N2 TG/DTG loss at 650 C.

Missing IMA:1985-052 indium-bearing orthorhombic Pmn21 stannite-group sulfide (Cu,Ag)2(Fe,Zn)(Sn,In)S4 from Herb claim, Mount Pleasant, and Ikuno mine (cotypes GSC 65049-65052); complete CM 27 (1989) 673-688 primary PDF inspected.

Missing IMA:1985-012 (Rn) tetragonal I-4 stannite-group Cu2FeSnS4 sulfide (a = 5.433(1) A, c = 10.884(2) A) from Cligga mine (cotypes GSC 65048 and BM 1984, 844); complete CM 27 (1989) 673-688 primary PDF inspected.
Missing IMA:1965-017 indium-dominant (Cu,Zn,Fe)3(In,Sn)S4 sulfide from Ikuno mine; complete CM 24 (1986) 405-409 and CM 27 (1989) 673-688 primary PDFs inspected.

Missing 1933 s.p. ammonium borate hydrate (NH4)3B15O20(OH)8(H2O)4 from Larderello; complete AM 18 (1933) 480-492 primary PDF and IMA Master List inspected, including Schaller's (NH4)2O.5B2O3.5H2O oxide ratio, cold-water sassolite washing, negative 20-30 C synthesis trials, and Merlino & Sartori (1971) structural formula.

Missing 1962 s.p. potassium uranyl silicate hydrate (K)2(UO2)2(Si5O13)(H2O)2.2H2O from Thomas Range; complete AM 45 (1960) 39-52 primary PDF inspected, including 150 C sealed-Pyrex hydrothermal synthesis.

Missing 1947 s.p. lead uranyl oxide hydrate from Shinkolobwe; complete CM 36 (1998) 187-199 primary triclinic P1 crystal-structure PDF inspected (R = 6.4%, wR = 7.7% for 3133 observed reflections; UO3 78.28 wt%, PbO 16.36 wt%, FeO 0.50 wt%, MgO 0.27 wt%).

deduplication.note: No pre-existing owner record in data/records/ matched any of the 14 selected commodities or mineral species prior to Round 117 creation.
